applies_to: Lutron Vive wireless lighting control systems with BACnet IP on the Vive hub (Vive 1.07); one hub device plus one virtual device per area.
summary: The Vive hub speaks BACnet IP and acts as a virtual router: each area (usually a room) is a virtual BACnet device behind it. The hub device carries the master load-shed BV. Each area device exposes light level and on/off, occupancy state and mode, occupied/unoccupied levels, load-shed settings and lighting power.
notes: BV 2 Master Load shed Enabled is on the Vive hub device; all other objects are on each area virtual device. AV 2 and BV 2 are different object types on different devices.
Device names come from the Vive configuration ({SystemName}, {AreaName}); each area's instance is the configured base number plus the area's device ID.
The table prints the BV 2 name over two lines ('Master Load shed' / 'Enabled'); it is joined here.
Occupancy Mode states 4 (Not Applicable) and 5 (Mixed) are read-only; writing them or state 1 returns a value out of range error.
Source: BACnet PIC Statement for Vive 369996d (05.09.18), Vive version 1.07.

integration.summary: Each room is a virtual device behind its Vive hub. Command lights with BV 3 (on/off) or AV 2 (level), read occupancy (MV 8) and lighting power, and use the hub's BV 2 for building-wide load shed with each area's BV 12/AV 13 settings.

minimum_points.name: Lighting State
minimum_points.why: Area lights on/off command and status

integration.enable: BACnet IP is set up in the Vive hub configuration; there is no BMS enable point.
setup: BACnet IP is embedded in the Vive hub; areas are virtual devices routed through it.
The hub can register as a foreign device with a BBMD.
gotchas: Writing BV 2 sheds lighting in every area of that hub that allows load shed.
Writing On to BV 3 drives dimmed loads to 100 %; use AV 2 to set a level instead.

points.name: Master Load shed Enabled
points.description: Load shed for all areas of the hub (hub device only)

points.name: Lighting Level
points.description: Highest light level in the area; writing sets all lights

points.name: Lighting State
points.description: On if any light in the area is on; writable

points.name: Disable Occupancy
points.description: True = occupancy sensors ignored in the area

points.name: Unoccupied Level
points.description: Dimmed level when the area goes unoccupied

points.name: Occupied Level
points.description: Dimmed level when the area goes occupied

points.name: Load shed Allowed
points.description: Whether this area takes part in load shed

points.name: Load shed Goal
points.description: Light level reduction during load shed, 0-90

points.name: Occupancy Mode
points.description: How occupancy sensors control the lights
points.states: 2=Automatic ON, Automatic OFF; 3=Manual ON, Automatic OFF; 4=Not Applicable (read-only); 5=Mixed (read-only)

points.name: Total Power
points.description: Present lighting power in the area

points.name: Maximum Power
points.description: Connected lighting load of the area
